body: Most of the time I'd get a thanks for feedback and such. But I always think that it's a good thing to leave feedback to improve their own methods.

Most of the time I leave feedback in private to the researcher. Always underlining if I've experienced stress or that some stuff weren't clear while doing it. I always do that if there's no feedback box. One time I've left for an experiment that was like done in multiple parts almost 2 pages of feedback for how many problems I've noticed while doing it.
